WITH per AS (
 SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date, period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period=1 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')),
store_sales AS (
 SELECT p.fiscal_year, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) gross_net
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN per p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date
 WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
store_ret AS (
 SELECT p.fiscal_year, s.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) ret
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN per p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.period_start_date AND p.period_end_date

elig AS (
 SELECT cur.store_id, cur.net_sales cur_ns, pri.net_sales pri_ns, cur.gross_net cg, pri.gross_net pg

SELECT count(*) stores, sum(pri_ns) prior, sum(cur_ns) cur, round((sum(cur_ns)/sum(pri_ns)-1)*100,2) lfl_pct, round((sum(cg)/sum(pg)-1)*100,2) lfl_before_returns FROM elig
